description: Create an eApp from a quote_id returned by any public quote tool and return its private apply_link. Call only after the user selects that quote and explicitly asks to start an application. Retries for the same quote reuse the eApp. Give the user the private apply_link and explain that they must open it to continue in Quote & Apply, complete the remaining application steps, and sign where required. This MCP action does not complete or submit the application to a carrier or bind coverage.

quote_id.description: Opaque quote_id from a public life quote tool; raw cache IDs and existing eApp IDs are not accepted

user_confirmed.description: The user selected this quote and explicitly requested starting an application

name: create_life_eapp
